# Brian T. Stoner, CPA

Brian T. Stoner is a certified public accountant in Burbank, California.
He prepares individual and business tax returns in all fifty states.
He plans taxes, handles estate planning and trust accounting, prepares payroll taxes, and reviews bookkeeping.
He works most with entertainment workers, professionals, real estate people, and construction trades.
His office is at 2600 W. Olive Ave., 5th Floor, Burbank, CA 91505.
He has been licensed as a California CPA since 1980 and opened his own firm in 2010.
He quotes a fixed fee before work starts and covers project phone and email time in the fee.
The first meeting is free.
Call (818) 317-6035 or email bstonercpa@sbcglobal.net to start.
Website: https://briantstonercpa.com/
